verses.pali: “Yesaṁ kesañci, bhikkhave, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo viraddho, viraddho tesaṁ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo sammā dukkhakkhayagāmī.
verses.english: “Mendicants, whoever has missed out on the noble eightfold path has missed out on the noble path to the complete ending of suffering.

verses.pali: Yesaṁ kesañci, bhikkhave, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo āraddho, āraddho tesaṁ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo sammā dukkhakkhayagāmī.
verses.english: Whoever has undertaken the noble eightfold path has undertaken the noble path to the complete ending of suffering.

verses.pali: Katamo ca, bhikkhave, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo?
verses.english: And what is the noble eightfold path?
It is right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right immersion.

verses.pali: Yesaṁ kesañci, bhikkhave, ayaṁ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo viraddho, viraddho tesaṁ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo sammā dukkhakkhayagāmī.
verses.english: Whoever has missed out on the noble eightfold path has missed out on the noble path to the complete ending of suffering.

verses.pali: Yesaṁ kesañci, bhikkhave, ayaṁ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo āraddho, āraddho tesaṁ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo sammā dukkhakkhayagāmī”ti.
verses.english: Whoever has undertaken the noble eightfold path has undertaken the noble path to the complete ending of suffering.”
